display.purpose: Hero headline only. Self-hosted Bricolage Grotesque 800, capped at 11ch so it stacks; the final line indents 0.52em and turns moss. Drops to clamp(3.25rem, 15.5vw, 4.6rem) below 768px.

headline.purpose: The wide section h2 in Bricolage Grotesque 700, used by the two section-intro headings. Capped at 12ch so it always wraps.

headline-compact.purpose: The same voice one step down, used by the plugin, evidence, and closing h2s. The evidence heading caps at 9ch.

title.purpose: Step and card headings in Bricolage Grotesque. Steps set 1.45rem; deployment cards set one step larger at 1.55rem.

lead.purpose: Section and closing body copy at 1.05rem/1.7. The hero lede runs 1.08rem on a 35rem measure.

body.purpose: Row and step descriptions at 1rem/1.6, capped at 54rem. Tinted mist 0.62-0.68.

label.purpose: Jump-nav links at 0.82rem/700. Hero fact rows run 0.84rem at mist 0.68.

caption.purpose: The hero evidence caption rail: 0.78rem, 0.08em tracking, uppercase, mist 0.55, with the real measured count in pollen. The trace figure caption uses the same size at weight 700 without uppercasing.

mono.purpose: Zero-padded step indices only (01, 02, 03), set 0.8rem in rain red. Never used for prose.

shadows.name: evidence-anchor
shadows.purpose: The hero capture frame. A large, very soft zero-offset pool in flower-black.

shadows.name: framed-capture
shadows.purpose: The secondary trace figure in the evidence section.

shadows.name: glass-card-hover
shadows.purpose: Incumbent documentation shell only: hovered translucent card in docs, plugins, and roadmap surfaces.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Color, background, and transform on the primary action and deployment paths.

motion.name: state-quick
motion.purpose: Opacity and transform on the jump-nav dot.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: The only positional hover movement in the garden. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: gravity-field
motion.value: requestAnimationFrame; 340px pointer influence, 1.7 x falloff^2 x depth acceleration, 0.9 tangential to 0.45 radial, 54px repulsive core, 0.972/0.978 damping, speed cap 16
motion.purpose: The single authored motion. Gated by IntersectionObserver (120px root margin), DPR capped at 2, pointer tracking gated on (pointer: fine), and reduced to one static frame under prefers-reduced-motion.

narrative.overview:
Lucia's public face is a dusk garden seen from inside: green-gray air, a slow directional rain of blue and red hairlines, and one black frame holding a real capture of the product's own record. The garden is not decoration around the product — it is the medium the product hangs in. Every surface is a tone of the same damp green, every divider is a hairline, and the only object allowed to be genuinely opaque and black is the frame around real evidence. The world earns attention by making one thing solid in a field of atmosphere.

The system proves rather than illustrates. There are no feature cards, no invented diagrams, and no stock imagery; the two hero-weight images are unretouched captures of the Lucia dashboard, and their captions carry real counts. Density is editorial rather than dashboard-like: long hairline ledgers of steps, plugins, and deployment paths, each row separated by a single pixel instead of a container. Type carries the drama — Bricolage Grotesque set enormous, tight, and sub-one leading against small quiet body copy — so the layout itself can stay calm.

Motion is singular and physical. One authored moment exists: the hero's canvas rain, in which the pointer behaves as a mass that bends drops into an orbit and slings them back out. Everything else in the system moves in short 160–180ms state changes and a two-pixel lift. The documentation shell retains the earlier warm teal-and-amber glass expression; that world still ships and is legitimate, but the garden is the normative world for new marketing and landing surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: A four-step green-black surface ladder, separated by tone and hairline rather than by cards or shadows.
Blue and red rain that only ever appears as a stroke, a wash, or a canvas hairline — never as a fill.
Self-hosted Bricolage Grotesque at 700/800 only, set huge with negative tracking and sub-one leading.
Asymmetric "leaf" corner radii on controls and figures, against a hard-square evidence anchor.
Real product captures as the only imagery, framed in flower-black and captioned with real numbers.
One authored motion (the pointer-as-mass gravity field), gated by visibility and reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Four Floors Rule
rules.body: Garden surfaces come from exactly four tones — flower-black, garden-deep, garden-band, garden. A new section picks one of the four. It does not invent a fifth tint, and it does not separate itself from its neighbour with a border when a tone change will do it.

rules.name: The Rain Never Fills Rule
rules.body: Rain blue and rain red exist only as 1px strokes, canvas hairlines, and washes at ≤0.34 alpha (section rain runs as low as 0.045). Neither color is ever a solid background, a button fill at rest, or a block of text. Their thinness is what makes them read as weather.

rules.name: The Pollen Grain Rule
rules.body: Pollen is punctuation, not a palette entry to spend. It marks focus, the one real number in the hero caption, and the appliance note. If a fourth pollen use appears on a surface, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Mist Ladder Rule
rules.body: Text below headline level is mist at descending alpha — 0.82 lede, 0.72 section body, 0.68 supporting copy, 0.62 row detail, 0.55 caption — and hairlines are moss at 0.12–0.26 or mist at 0.14–0.18. Reach for an alpha step before reaching for a new gray.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Only 700 and 800 exist as font files. Never specify another Bricolage weight, and never an italic — there is no face behind it, and the browser will synthesize a counterfeit.

rules.name: The Sub-One Leading Rule
rules.body: Display and headline set below 1.0 line-height (0.86 and 0.95) with negative tracking; body and lead never go below 1.5. The compression is reserved for the voice, never applied to reading copy.

rules.name: The Quiet Body Rule
rules.body: The system stack is not a fallback that lost — it is the deliberate second voice. Do not promote body copy to Bricolage to add emphasis; change size, alpha, or measure instead.

rules.name: The Hairline Ledger Rule
rules.body: Repeating content is separated by 1px rules at mist 0.16, not by cards, backgrounds, or gaps. A row's only container is the line above and below it.

rules.name: The Reach Rule
rules.body: Interactive rows and controls hold real touch targets — 48px minimum on the primary action, 44px on text actions — even though the visual language is thin.

rules.name: The Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: Only frames holding real product captures cast a shadow. Every other surface in the garden is flat and is separated from its neighbour by tone and hairline. A new shadow on a new element is a signal that the element should have been a hairline.

rules.name: The Zero-Offset Rule
rules.body: Depth is a pool directly beneath, never a hard offset slab. Both shadows have no horizontal offset and a blur several times their vertical drop.

rules.name: The Leaf Corner Rule
rules.body: Controls and figures use asymmetric radii with one deliberately sharp corner; evidence frames stay square. Never apply a uniform radius to a garden control, and never round the corners of a frame holding a real capture.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: The system carries exactly one authored motion. Everything else is a 160–180ms state transition and a ≤2px lift. A second ambient animation anywhere on a garden surface is a defect, not an enhancement.

dos: Do build sections from the four garden tones and separate them with 1px hairlines (moss 0.12–0.26, mist 0.14–0.18) instead of borders-plus-cards.
Do step body copy down the mist alpha ladder (0.82 → 0.55) rather than introducing new gray tokens.
Do give controls and figures asymmetric leaf radii, and keep frames around real captures square.
Do use real, unretouched Lucia dashboard captures as imagery, with real numbers in the caption rail and explicit width/height on every .
Do set display type huge, tight, and clamped to a character count so it wraps into stacked lines.
Do gate any canvas work behind IntersectionObserver, cap device pixel ratio at 2, and render a single static frame under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep the 3px pollen focus ring at 4px offset on every interactive element.
Do draw icons as inline Lucide SVGs sized 1rem–2rem and marked aria-hidden when adjacent text carries the meaning.
donts: Don't fill any surface, button rest state, or text block with rain blue or rain red; they are stroke and wash colors only.
Don't spend pollen beyond focus, the one real caption number, and the appliance mark.
Don't request a Bricolage Grotesque weight other than 700 or 800, or an italic — no font file exists and the browser will synthesize one.
Don't promote body copy to the display face for emphasis; change size, alpha, or measure.
Don't add a shadow to anything that isn't a frame holding a real product capture, and never use a hard offset shadow — the depth model is a soft zero-offset pool.
Don't add a second ambient animation to a garden surface; the gravity field is the only authored motion.
Don't use uppercase tracked type outside figure captions and compact metadata labels; headings and prose are never set in caps.
Don't blend the incumbent teal/amber glass shell into a garden surface, and don't swap the semantic jobs of Lucia Cyan (routing) and Alert Gold (attention) where that shell still ships.
Don't propagate the incumbent emoji glyph icons from the roadmap component into new surfaces; they are a carried defect, not a system primitive — use inline Lucide SVGs.
